title: SUPERSEDED — historical DIMSTYLE DIMCLRD/E/T bit-short correction
status: superseded; do not use as format evidence
correction: The earlier ODA interpretation was incorrect. ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.68 specifies DIMCLRD, DIMCLRE, and DIMCLRT as CMC; the generated BS-only test was self-consistent but not independent wire evidence.
scope: Correct R2000+ DIMCLRD, DIMCLRE, and DIMCLRT DWG encoding from CMC to ordinary BS
Preserve DIMTFILLCLR as the distinct R2007+ CMC field
Verify independent field order, production parse round-trip, and following stream boundaries

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: SUPERSEDED: the prior claim that DIMCLRD/E/T are BS was a misread. ODA §20.4.68 specifies all three as CMC; see the corrective 2026-10-22 receipt.

localSource.finding: The modern DIMSTYLE parser and writer now use bounded BS reads and putBitShort for DIMCLRD/E/T. The separate DIMTFILLCLR remains on the existing bounded CMC reader and CMC writer path.
localSource.compatibility: No public layout or virtual interface changed.

generatedControls.finding: Generated values 42, 0, and 256 are independently decoded as the three consecutive BS fields, followed by a distinct DIMADEC sentinel. Production parse retains the values and parent handle; an independent handle-stream walk checks the following generated sentinel.
generatedControls.limit: Generated writer/parser controls establish local codec consistency only; they are not producer-authored or native-consumer evidence.

productionSummary: Read modern DIMCLRD/E/T values with readBodyShort rather than readBodyColor.
Write DIMCLRD/E/T with putBitShort rather than putCmColor.
Keep DIMTFILLCLR on the CMC path as specified by ODA.
